template_name: QDM Finished Lot Yield Dashboard Requirement Template
description: A business requirement template parsed from the D.CHQ.QDM Finished Lot Yield Dashboard requirement document. It covers finished lot yield trend, output and loss KPIs, defect-code Pareto, filter interactions, data contract, yield calculation rules, chart inventory, UI rules, technical specifications, and acceptance criteria. Original embedded images are represented as text descriptions.
applicable_scenarios: Weekly / monthly / quarterly yield trend analysis
Defect-code loss ratio Pareto and cause-department analysis
Manufacturing yield formula and data-contract confirmation
Responsive dashboard implementation with export and permission rules

prompt_hints.content: The original screenshots were converted to text descriptions; ask the user to confirm whether those descriptions match the intended final UI.
The metric name NSQM / NSOM appears inconsistently in the source; confirm the approved label before implementation.
Confirm whether the yield formula should include only PAOI, E-test, CCAOI, Bump AOI, and FVI, or also Inline and Others as shown in the calculation example.

prompt_questions.content: Which layout is approved for the first release: Primary-Detail / Hero, Nested drill-down, Uniform Grid, or another pattern?
What are the final join keys and query filters for the two QDM source tables?
Which roles can export chart images or underlying data?
What refresh cadence and data availability SLA should be shown on the page?
